page.overview:
Who is Gregor?

Gregor is a Cobra operative who posed as a journalist and assisted the Baroness in kidnapping Dr. Adele Burkhart.

Disguised as a camera crew, The Baroness, Gregor, and an unnamed man in a blue suit infiltrated a train transporting the nuclear physicist Dr. Adele Burkhart. They used weapons disguised as their cameras to surprise the Secret Service. The Baroness ordered Gregor to cover her escape with Dr. Burkhart. Gregor was left behind as The Baroness exited with the physicist through a window using an inflatable balloon.
